title: LITcoder: A General-Purpose Library for Building and Comparing Encoding Models

layout.note: Five dashed rounded panels in a 3 + 2 grid on white: the top row holds the numbered stages 1 to 3, the bottom row a narrow System-wide logger panel at the left and the wide stage 4 at the right. Inside each stage the flow is top-down: title, inputs or drawings, an arrow to a pink-headed class card listing its options, an arrow to the data it returns in a grey rounded box; stage 4 runs left to right instead.

lesson: For a library, give every stage the same panel template: a numbered title, inputs, an arrow to a card that names the class and lists its options with vertical bars, and a grey box with the data it returns; carry one toy sentence through the stages so the data shapes are visible.
